judgements.reason: Not reaching the top is no reason to stop caring and trying.
Out of step with peers? Perhaps you hear a different drummer.
Urgent 'stop drifting' could deepen the sense of failure.
Generic control-dichotomy; doesn't meet the bind with a mother.
Seek people who think well of you; a thin side-step.
Lament of constant strife; mentions mother but not this conflict.
See where her opinions come from; stop craving her approval.
A mother unable to understand; partial echo only.
I must be myself; love me as I am, or I'll still deserve it.
Praises relentless correction; could read as endorsing her pressure.
A mother's claim on her son's trouble; off-target here.
Letting go of resentment; formulaic, misses the guilt and bind.
Suffering leads to confusion or an endless search for a cure.
Pain growing, not fading, met with a teaching; mirrors the state.
'Do something!' is harsh for someone exhausted by trying.
Frames pain as discipline; healing note but could feel blaming.
Troubles as dreams; dismissive of physical pain.
Only the present moment hurts; take pain one moment at a time.
Becoming a friend to yourself means never being wholly alone.
God keeps fatherless children; ambiguous and oblique here.
Fear nothing, be at peace; too abstract for this situation.
Bear patiently and trust; generic.
Don't be ashamed to need help to do your duty.
Calm like a child with its mother; gentle image, loose fit.
You needn't do everything, just something; faint link.
Children come through you; eases the fear of having to be perfect.
Child as a mother's dream; tender but slight.
About a son's mortality; unsuitable for a frightened expectant mother.
Covering an offence keeps friendship; voices one side of the bind.
Focus on your own conduct; doesn't address the dilemma.
Confess to one another; tangential.
About renunciation and hypocrisy; off-topic.
About visiting friends without apology; off-topic.
Tolerate or break with annoying friends; misses the moral bind.
Leave another's wrongdoing with him; one angle on the choice.
Warns adulterers; about the friend, not the person's choice.
Open rebuke beats hidden love: confront the friend honestly.
Forced smiles in company; small echo of workplace strain.
Why seek approval from someone displeased with himself?
Accept help; tangential to a belittling boss.
Permission to voice bitterness; matches the daily torment.
Self-imposed slavery; could imply they chose this.
Act your given part well, though you didn't choose it.
His conduct is outside your power; don't let it define you.
Nobody has anything finished; we all postpone. Eases the shame.
Catalogue of bodily decline; bleak for this person.
Where did the years go: life is a point, many steps, short climb.
Be content with your allotted time.
Giving up youth's vanity; about recoiling at the old, not regret.
'Never read the books saved for old age' could sting.
Busyness isn't happiness; only loosely relevant.
Life's value in possibilities; a faint thread.
Stop overthinking; enjoy what you find.
The world is dull or rich depending on how we see it.
Stop drifting; generic urgency.
Craving the future comes from not having found oneself.
Mortals chasing what also dies: names the futility felt.
Find the purpose of life as a whole, not its parts.
Poverty is mere opinion; dismissive of world suffering.
Explains the root of strife; doesn't help hold the darkness.
Pain is your judgement; cold toward real cruelty.
Grow goodness within and you see more of it outside.
Cosmic perspective; generic.
Asks how to keep sadness out, but scolding tone.
Counter a bad influence with a contrary one.
About personal darkness; not the world's.
Don't try to fix the whole world; help those near you.
Love even under torture; graphic and demanding here.
Darkness travels towards light; brief hope.
Says darkness never existed; denies what they see.
The world is burning; wrapped in darkness, seek a light.
Submit your will to authority; wrong message here.
Religion is heart-realisation, not consent; speaks to faking it.
Truth must come in your own soul's language.
Letting go of resentment; terse, misses the betrayal's hurt.
No one keeps what they hear; secrets spread.
Belief alone doesn't help; only loosely related.
Good to be born in a church, bad to never grow beyond it.
Submit to authority; wrong for this doubt.
Piety without deeds; touches hypocrisy but inward-facing.
Churches count little next to inner spirituality.
Procrastinating conversion; off-target.
Prayer means nothing if we don't treat others as brothers.
Consider God's works; too slight here.
Drop the complaint of harm; dismissive of real hurt.
Opinion makes the insult; doesn't meet the mixed feelings.
Asks forgiveness for one's own sins; off-target.
Let the dead past bury its dead; the future is open.
A father wronged by his sons; inverts their situation.
However he behaved, I choose how I act now.
Command to forgive; pushy for raw anger.
Insult is opinion; generic.
Honour your father; would land badly given the past.
Let go of the past and act justly now.
Formulaic resentment release.
Treat your life so far as done; abstract fresh start.
No damage unless you think so; minimises past harm.
Grudges keep hatred alive; letting go lays it to rest.
The body is a cloak; the scabbard doesn't make the sword.
Self-condemnation and hidden sores; off-target.
About walking alone; off-topic.
Wrongdoers don't love themselves; implies blame.
Weight as analogy for lifespan; could land badly.
Care for your body, leave externals; loose fit.
Unhappy if you think so; dismissive.
Others' opinions are nothing; but the self-loathing is inward.
About difficult people; 'ugly' used differently.
A mouth seeking bread; obscure here.
Eating in moderation; reads as a lecture right now.
Reproach has broken my heart; no comforters found.
Think nothing, become nothing; adds pressure.
'Never be weak' would feel harsh in a spiral.
Another's opinion of you is outside your will.
Someone spoke ill; that you were harmed is your addition.
Don't gaze at your own image, fair or ugly; look to love.
Generic impression-testing.
Says you invited the blow; blames them.
Walk alone, don't hide in the chorus; find who you are.
Don't envy the applauded; they're no happier.
Look at whose approval you seek and you'll stop craving it.
Comparing ourselves with others lacks understanding.
Accept company contentedly; loose fit and slightly scolding.
Own life over others' opinions, but stresses income too.
Have something to give; vague link to writing.
You imagine things; off-topic and dismissive.
Learn to obey rules first; wrong message.
Business as harsh master; off-topic.
Author's modest closing; off-topic.
Scholar and poet; honours poets but doesn't touch the choice.
Practical people live off dreamers; affirms the writer's worth.
Expect nothing from children; doesn't meet the guilt.
Love for a child brings pain; redirects to God, sidesteps repair.
Praises a father's correction; could seem to justify the harshness.
My children have gone from me; this grief I must bear.
Have you wronged? Add no more, and seek forgiveness.
Children aren't ours to shape; names what went wrong gently.
Remember me by your kindness, not my past wrongs.
Accept being outdone; not about a spouse's coolness.
Praises growth in good qualities; off-topic.
Office is external; misses the marital hurt.
Chasing honours is derided; deflating and off-target.
Desire outruns satisfaction; their issue is old anger, not craving.
Direct anger at God; tangential.
Set aside money and look into your soul for your worth.
Don't grieve too much, weep but don't wail; harsh to a bereaved parent.
Memory of the lost stings, yet holds sweetness; gentle.
David's lost child: I will go to him, he won't return.
Mother unmoved by son's execution; would wound.
Relations superseded; odd note for an engagement.
Great things done for me; joyful thanksgiving.
Rings aren't gifts; quirky, partly deflating.
Go out with joy; the hills sing and trees clap.
Pain of separation; wrong for happiest day.
May gladness be born in your house, from within.
Truth known always, spoken only sometimes: timing a reveal.
Insight arriving unannounced; off-topic.
Hesitating over conversion; off-topic.
Whom to confide in; not about holding a happy surprise.
Harmless lies; off-topic.
Be happy rather than seem so; off-topic.
Secret things belong to God; only a word match.
Which efforts to make; off-topic.
Teaching children; misses the pain of watching them struggle.
Spilling water on the way; faint, playful echo at best.
Fish parable about other worlds; off-topic.
Insatiable monster; off-topic.
Joy despite repeated failures; loosely about patience.
Diogenes and Daedalus; off-topic.
Don't judge others' acts; off-topic.
Fishing and self-respect; off-topic.
Rest in quiet; don't weary the body.
Withered and worn out; voices exhaustion.
Facing death and fleeting life; too heavy for tiredness.
Sleeping untroubled; loosely about rest.
Souls crushed under their load; names the exhaustion.
Restless moving about; off-topic.
Heartbreak from insults; wrong register.
Slow of foot steps out; light, loose link.
Near-death anguish; far too heavy for sore feet.
Humanity's tightrope; off-topic.
Dusting limestone; off-topic.
Weary of life; wrong for a light complaint.
